paper.core_task: Benchmarking multimodal large language models on low-level visual perception, description, and assessment.

contributions.name: A comprehensive benchmark for low-level visual abilities of MLLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We construct Q-Bench, a benchmark to examine the progresses of MLLMs on low-level visual abilities.
contributions.description: A benchmark called Q-Bench that systematically evaluates MLLMs on three low-level visual abilities: perception, description, and assessment.

contributions.name: A softmax-based quantitative IQA strategy for MLLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We propose a unified softmax-based quantitative IQA strategy on MLLMs.
contributions.description: A strategy that extracts logit probabilities of 'good' and 'poor' tokens from MLLMs and uses softmax pooling to produce quantifiable quality scores that correlate with human opinions.

contributions.name: Novel benchmark datasets for low-level vision evaluation
contributions.author_claim_text: We collect two multi-modality benchmark datasets for low-level vision.
contributions.description: The LLVisionQA dataset for perception with 2,990 image-question-answer tuples and the LLDescribe dataset for description with 499 images and expert-written golden descriptions.

novelty_claims.text: The proposal of a softmax-based quality assessment strategy is innovative, as it bridges the gap between language models and traditional IQA frameworks.
